blueprint.business_goal: Help Codex make faster, safer development decisions while reducing unnecessary reasoning and repeated setup.

excluded: changing the model of an already running turn
creating threads without an explicit delegated thread tool call

definition_of_done: UserPromptSubmit hook is trusted and active
PreToolUse routing hook is trusted and active
Installed hook calls typesafe-ai/jev through Vercel AI Gateway
Installed hook identifies JEV or local fallback on every decision
Delegated create_thread and send_message_to_thread calls receive the selected runtime model and reasoning
Public documentation, license, security policy, contribution guide, and release checklist are present
